description: Source code for an ATM driver core functions for Infineon Lantiq hardware, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and control operations.

methods.name: ase_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version major and minor numbers.

methods.name: ase_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware components and prepares the ATM driver.

methods.name: ase_start
methods.description: Downloads firmware binary and starts the PP32 processor.

methods.name: init_pmu
methods.description: Enables power management units for specific modules.

methods.name: uninit_pmu
methods.description: Disables power management units (currently commented out).

methods.name: pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware code and data to PP32.
